formulas.tex: r_0=b-Ax_0,\ p_0=r_0,\ q=Ap,\quad\term{alpha}{\alpha}=\frac{r^Tr}{p^Tq},\quad\term{solution}{x'}=x+\alpha p,\quad r'=r-\alpha q,\quad\term{beta}{\beta}=\frac{r'^Tr'}{r^Tr},\quad p'=r'+\beta p
formulas.ascii: r0=b-A*x0; p0=r0; rr=r dot r. While rr>toleranceSquared, at most maxIterations: q=A*p; pq=p dot q; breakdown=(pq<=0), active=(pq>0); alpha=rr/pq; x+=alpha*p; r-=alpha*q; newRR=r dot r; beta=newRR/rr; p=r+beta*p; rr=newRR; active=(rr>toleranceSquared). Active gates subsequent lowered operations; no preconditioner and no relative tolerance.

if (begin >= end || localIndex >= end - begin) { break; }
fn reduceValue(value: f32, lane: u32, subgroupInvocationId: u32, subgroupSize: u32, subgroupId: u32) -> f32 {
if (index < 256u) { value = inputValues[0u + index] * inputValues[0u + index]; }
let total = reduceValue(value, lane, subgroupInvocationId, subgroupSize, subgroupId);
if (index < 256u) { value = inputValues[0u + index] * inputBValues[0u + index]; }
